title: SoccerBeat
tagline: Nextgen Dance Dance Revolution using no additional device other than your camera! GameFi from your phone and laptop.
description:
We've created a football game "SoccerBeats" demo in 2 days. Our vision is to make it easy for every player to enjoy a movement game, without additional devices - just using their phone or laptop camera.

We achieved this with open source motion capture technology - VNect-tensorflow. We also have 3D avatar enabled, and uses Unity's asset store materials and Nico Nico materials, such as our 3D girl avatar and red jacket, as stand-in assets for the game. 

We want to extend this game design to multiple scenes overtime. It is easily re-skinnable to new holidays or events, like the world cup, halloween, Christmas, Chinese new year, and Super Bowl. We also want to add social features to increase social connectiveness.
how_its_made:
This project has 2 parts: game rendering and web3 hookups.

For the game we used Unity engine for game building and the Unity asset store for in game assets. 

The NFTs are minted on the ETH chain.

We used React for frontend, Metamask for wallet connection, and 1combo for the composable NFT API.

https://testnet.1combo.io/
